approaches.description: CONTRIBUTING.md does not require a changelog entry; RELEASING.md asks for one per release. PR #178 (external Windows ARM64) touched only build-wheels.yml and pyproject.toml and its line arrived in Release 2.4.0 (#191, 0c01818); in #151 the aarch64 line came from maintainer commit aa74477.
approaches.evidence: pull_request_read get_files closeio/ciso8601#151 and #178; git log -- CHANGELOG.md.
approaches.lesson: Changelog lines for architecture rows are added by maintainers; PR offers to add one.
approaches.title: Pass verdict without CHANGELOG entry

review_loop.summary: 3 rounds of fresh reviewer children (3, 2, 2 reviewers) on the unchanged one-commit series and the PR text. Rounds 1 and 2 returned OK with notes (P2 text notes only); each was fixed in the text. Round 3 reviewers both returned OK with no findings on exactly the delivered series and text.

Three review rounds; all findings were P2 text notes, fixed; last round clean.
